name: captureflow
description: Turn a chat into a presentation, how-to or walkthrough video and share it as a link.

interface.longDescription:
CaptureFlow turns what you tell ChatGPT into a video you can share as a link.

Describe a presentation, a how-to or a walkthrough and ChatGPT builds it slide by slide: title and step slides, your screenshots with a ring around what to click, code with the lines that matter highlighted, and a closing slide. Ask for a voiceover and it narrates every slide. You get a link to the finished video, with chapters for each slide and a transcript.

You can also list and search the recordings in your CaptureFlow library, read their transcripts, and change who can watch them.

It's for people who need a demo, a how-to for a colleague or customer, a release walkthrough or a short explainer without opening a video editor.

Limitations: images must be at public http(s) links. It doesn't record your computer or sign in to websites; the CaptureFlow extension, app and local agent do that. Video minutes are limited each month, and voiceover needs a Pro plan.
capabilities: Build a presentation or how-to video from slides
Frame screenshots with a callout on what matters
Narrate a video with an AI voice
Change who can watch a recording
defaultPrompt: Make a one-minute how-to video on setting up two-factor authentication, with a title slide, the steps and a closing slide.
Turn these release notes into a short narrated walkthrough video.
Find my recordings about onboarding and show me the transcript of the newest one.

positive.description: Make a how-to video from a description
positive.prompt: Make a short how-to video on resetting a forgotten password, with a title slide, the three steps and a closing slide.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a share link to a video that opens on a title slide, shows the steps, and ends on a closing slide.

positive.description: Make a video with a screenshot and a callout
positive.prompt: Make a one-slide video that shows https://captureflow.dev/og.png with a ring around the top left corner and the caption 'Start here'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a share link to a video with the image framed, a ring at the top left, and the caption under it.
Lists the account's recordings with their titles and links.

positive.prompt: Show me the transcript of my newest recording.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the timestamped text of the newest recording.

positive.description: Change who can watch a recording
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the newest recording's visibility to private and confirms the change.

negative.description: General knowledge question, unrelated to video, so the plugin should not be used.
Writing request with no video involved, so the plugin should not be used.
negative.prompt: Write me a video script about coffee.

negative.description: The plugin can't record the user's computer, so it should explain that it makes videos from slides and point to the CaptureFlow apps for screen recording, without starting anything.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: build presentation, how-to and walkthrough videos from slides, with screenshots, callouts, code and an optional AI voiceover; list and search recordings, read transcripts, and change who can watch a recording.
